summary: E2E validation of unified Empresa signup (public POST /company-signup -> admin approve in 'Company KYB' -> EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED login gate -> verify-email -> login OK). Backend pytest 11/11 pass. UI: register dialog Personal/Empresa selector, CompanySignupDialog (all fields + 2 uploads + password-mismatch msg + submit gating), success screen, admin Company KYB tab (no company-requests tab, Documents column with working /api/files links 200 image/png), Approve and Reject via UI, profile without 'Programa Empresas' - all PASS. One UI layout bug in success screen found and fixed by testing agent. All QA data cleaned.

minor.issue: For anonymous signups parent_user_id is set to the synthetic 'anon_xxx' id; notify_requester_company_active / blocklist verify-phone path would try to notify a non-existent user. Harmless now (account is born active) but should be None when requester_anonymous=true.

ui_bugs.issue: had 'flex items-start gap-2' with raw text nodes + , so the message split into 3 narrow columns. FIXED by wrapping text in a (+break-all on email). Verified via screenshot.

issues: All strings are hardcoded Spanish (no t()/i18n) while EmailAuthDialog and admin use i18n; English users see a Spanish form.

action_items: Optional: set parent_user_id=None for requester_anonymous company accounts in _build_company_user_doc
critical_code_review_comments: conftest.py globally injects X-Captcha-Bypass into requests; tests checking CAPTCHA_REQUIRED must override header with a wrong value (done in new test).

Frontend submit is disabled while Turnstile token is missing (correct); headless Playwright cannot solve Turnstile, so UI tests mock GET /api/captcha/config to enforced:false while the backend still enforces and is passed via X-Captcha-Bypass header.
Validated: duplicate pending email 409, existing-user email 409, password mismatch 422, invalid data URL 422, reject removes password_hash and 7-day cooldown returns 429, login without captcha 400.
